subject: Invitation to Sarah's Birthday Party
body: Hi everyone, I hope this email finds you well. I'm excited to invite you all to Sarah's birthday party next Saturday at 7 PM. The party will be held at her place and we'll have food, drinks, and games. Please RSVP by replying to this email if you can make it. Feel free to bring a plus one if you'd like. Looking forward to celebrating with all of you! Best regards, Emily
